simple.meaning: אַרְבַּע (ʼarbaʻ) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “four.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 320 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 1 more, beginning at Genesis 2:10. Its contexts include family, family line, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אַרְבַּע (H702).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: אַרְבַּע (ʼarbaʻ) / H702 is traced through Genesis 2:10, Genesis 11:13, Genesis 11:15, Genesis 11:16 as a generated source-based concept entry.
